description: Start a review session: one retrieval scene per concept due, taken from the lessons the learner studied — mastered concepts whose recall is due, then reviewed ones still weak. Play it like a lesson (submit_response, rate_recall); its answers update the learner's memory and mastery, and it is never recorded as a lesson completed. With now_ms it runs on a clock anchored there (its answers and ratings are dated from it). Returns {status: "started", session_id, review: {items, not_playable?}, presentation, ...}, or {status: "nothing_due", next_review_at, next_review_date, display_markdown, not_playable?} saying when the next review falls; not_playable names the concepts due that no lesson on disk can review any more.

language.description: fr or en: the language of display_markdown and of the next step; defaults to the language of the learner's last lesson, else the server's

learner_id.description: omit it: this server plays one learner (persistence.learner_id_default), and an id passed here is ignored

now_ms.description: epoch ms, for deterministic scheduling: the session started with it stamps its answers, ratings and reviews there; defaults to the server clock

name: start_review_session
